referenceScenes.purpose: Supine adult, operating room, patient shell, abdominal wall, thorax, abdominal and pelvic context, bowel, mesentery, ileocecal continuity, and staged procedural cameras.
registrationNotes: Patient shell height is 13.4 world units for a 175 cm adult.
Patient anatomy is rotated [-0.13, 0.035, 0] and the supported shell uses z=-0.73.
The reference abdomen is anisotropically fitted to the shell; reusable frames below expose centimetres so generated modules do not repeat those nested transforms.

referenceScenes.purpose: Right preperitoneal groin, inferior epigastric and external iliac vessels, deep ring, Cooper ligament, iliopubic tract, cord structures, hernia spaces, ports, and injury-control views.
registrationNotes: All operative anatomy was authored in centimetres and converted once with 13.4/175.
The right-groin local origin is [0, 0.36, -0.95] inside the rotated patient frame.
Field depth is derived from named vascular, ligament, ring, cord, and pelvic anchors rather than an arbitrary flat sheet.

referenceScenes.purpose: Stable right-upper-quadrant centres, nominal extents, attachment landmarks, and human-frame registration for request-specific generated hepatobiliary anatomy. The calibrated HuBMAP liver scaffold is implemented separately in renderer/atlas/RegisteredOrganAssets.tsx.
registrationNotes: The regional origin is the calibrated right subhepatic/hilar origin from the Surgical Atlas patient.
Normal structure centres and extents are fixed; phase, exposure, pathology, anatomical variation, instruments, overlays, and cameras remain request-specific.
The HuBMAP liver asset is used as reusable anatomical geometry with its source licence retained beside the viewer asset.
